title: KestrelCare Vehicle Service Contracts Declarations Schedule: Terms, Deductibles and Vehicle Limits
content:
Every KestrelCare Vehicle Service Contracts plan is written with a term and a per-visit deductible taken from the options of its own coverage level, on a vehicle that is within that level's limits at the plan sale. The rows below are the declarations figures for each of the six coverage levels.

## Term options

A term is a number of months and a number of miles. The term months run from the plan's sale date to its expiration date; the term miles are added to the odometer at sale to give the expiration odometer.

| Coverage level | Terms offered (months / miles) |
|---|---|
| KestrelCare Powertrain | 24 / 24000; 36 / 36000; 48 / 48000 |
| KestrelCare Powertrain Plus | 36 / 36000; 48 / 48000; 60 / 60000 |
| KestrelCare Silver | 36 / 36000; 48 / 50000; 60 / 60000 |
| KestrelCare Gold | 36 / 36000; 48 / 50000; 60 / 75000 |
| KestrelCare Platinum | 36 / 45000; 48 / 60000; 60 / 75000; 72 / 100000 |
| KestrelCare Platinum Exclusionary | 36 / 45000; 48 / 60000; 60 / 75000; 72 / 100000 |

## Deductible options

The buyer chooses one per-visit deductible at the sale, from the options of the plan bought.

| Coverage level | Deductibles offered (USD per repair visit) |
|---|---|
| KestrelCare Powertrain | 100.00 or 250.00 |
| KestrelCare Powertrain Plus | 0.00, 100.00 or 250.00 |
| KestrelCare Silver | 0.00, 100.00 or 250.00 |
| KestrelCare Gold | 0.00, 100.00 or 250.00 |
| KestrelCare Platinum | 0.00, 100.00 or 250.00 |
| KestrelCare Platinum Exclusionary | 0.00, 100.00 or 250.00 |

## Vehicle limits at the plan sale

The model age is the calendar year of the plan sale less the vehicle's model year. The odometer is the reading on the declarations page at the sale.

| Coverage level | Maximum model age (years) | Maximum odometer (miles) | Vehicle in commercial use |
|---|---|---|---|
| KestrelCare Powertrain | 15 | 175000 | not accepted |
| KestrelCare Powertrain Plus | 12 | 150000 | not accepted |
| KestrelCare Silver | 10 | 125000 | not accepted |
| KestrelCare Gold | 10 | 120000 | not accepted |
| KestrelCare Platinum | 8 | 100000 | not accepted |
| KestrelCare Platinum Exclusionary | 6 | 80000 | not accepted |

## Purchase window, vehicle count and financing

| Coverage level | Post-sale purchase window (calendar days, handover date is day 0) | Only one pending or active KestrelCare plan per vehicle | Plan price may be included in a Kestrel Auto Finance contract signed with the vehicle |
|---|---|---|---|
| KestrelCare Powertrain | 90 | yes | yes |
| KestrelCare Powertrain Plus | 90 | yes | yes |
| KestrelCare Silver | 90 | yes | yes |
| KestrelCare Gold | 90 | yes | yes |
| KestrelCare Platinum | 90 | yes | yes |
| KestrelCare Platinum Exclusionary | 90 | yes | yes |

The post-sale purchase window is the number of calendar days after the vehicle handover date within which a plan can still be bought without an inspection.

## Reading the limits (hypothetical vehicles)

- A vehicle of model year 2017 offered a plan in calendar year 2025 has a model age of 8 years. That is within the maximum of KestrelCare Platinum (8) and above the maximum of KestrelCare Platinum Exclusionary (6).
- A vehicle showing 120000 miles at the sale is within the maximum of KestrelCare Gold (120000) and above the maximum of KestrelCare Platinum (100000).
- A KestrelCare Silver buyer choosing 48 months takes the 50000-mile term of that row; on an odometer of 30000 at the sale, the expiration odometer is 80000.
